steps.label: Liveness check
Precondition: the render-scene state is queryable and returns a JSON object (the shipped default background is a synthesized stage)
A visible fluid + rigid scene sharing the glTF background's camera
Load the hand-written stage GLB (floor + 2 walls + obstacle block) as the background set
The render-scene state is still a JSON object after the load
Identity transform is accepted
Shared directional light
Load the synthetic cube map (SSFR reflections + SSFR-mode skybox)
Enable the IBL flag
Advance the fluid a few frames so the capture isn't the static spawn pose
Hot-reload the same background (loadDocument path, no pipeline rebuild)
Clear the environment back to the shipped default
Disable IBL again
Clear the background entirely
Reload the stage for the capture
Screenshot round-trip completes with the glTF background + fluid composited on one camera
Invariant: the app is still alive after the load/reload/clear/capture round-trip
Neg: a nonexistent background path is rejected
Neg: a degenerate light direction is rejected
Neg: a transform with the wrong argument count is rejected
Neg: a non-positive background scale is rejected
